articleTitle: Dynamic State Estimation of Sub-Transient Synchronous Generator Model Using Unscented Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: States of synchronous generator are essential for monitoring, control, and fault detection. However, not all states are measurable for those purposes. This paper proposes Dynamic State Estimation (DSE) generators using terminal measurements. The proposed method uses a nonlinear filtering technique known as Unscented Kalman Filter (UKF). To accurately represent the behavior of a synchronous generator, the sub-transient model is utilized. The outcomes of the estimator are compared with the actual states. The robustness of the proposal method is tested on an SMIB system using various scenarios such as short circuits, measurement and process noise, and step input. The results of this paper demonstrate that the UKF method is able to provide accurate state estimates of the sub-transient synchronous generator model from noisy terminal measurements.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Farming: CNN-Based Rice Leaf Disease Identification and Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This research investigates the performance of three distinct neural network models, including the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture, InceptionV3, and Xception, for classifying rice plant diseases. Evaluation metrics encompassing accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score were employed to assess the models' efficacy in classifying diseases (Blast, Blight, and Tungro). The findings reveal that the Xception Transfer Learning Model outperformed the other models, achieving an average accuracy of 0.97. InceptionV3 also exhibited strong performance, with an average accuracy of 0.95. Meanwhile, the CNN Architecture model presented lower performance, with an average accuracy of 0.94. Confusion matrices were analyzed for each model, offering comprehensive insights into classification performance. These results facilitate the selection of the most suitable model for disease classification in rice plants, with the Xception Transfer Learning Model emerging as the preferred choice.

articleTitle: Cryptocurrency Price Movement Prediction Using the Hybrid SARIMAX-LSTM Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In the digital age, the growth of blockchain technology, underpinning cryptocurrency, has been undeniable since its debut with Bitcoin in 2009. While the cryptocurrency market offers vast profit potential, its price volatility poses a significant challenge to investors and traders. Addressing this challenge, this study proposes a prediction method that fuses SARIMAX and LSTM into a Hybrid SARIMAX-LSTM model, considering trading volume as an exogenous factor. Through evaluation metrics like MSE, RMSE, MAPE, and MAE, it was found that this hybrid model provides more accurate forecasts than singular models, showcasing its potential to counteract cryptocurrency market volatility..

articleTitle: Design And Build Of Temperature Control System To Increase The Growth Rate Of Neon Tetra Fish And Egeria Densa Plant In Aquascape
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In maintaining an aquarium or aquascape, water is the most important element and must be properly maintained for the survival of living things such as fish and aquatic plants. Living things in an aquascape will live well if the water used in the aquascape is of good quality. Currently Aquascaping is a trend and a hobby among aquatic environmentalists and fish fans because it is a form of entertainment to relieve stress after work and the art of raising fish. However, caring for the aquascape itself tends to be difficult because you have to consider parameters that are appropriate for the biota in it, such as the temperature that must be maintained in the aquascape. Therefore, in this final project, an Aquascape with a temperature control system will be made by monitoring PH and dissolved oxygen which is equipped with a Cooling Peltier and HPL Lamp to maintain the temperature in the Aquascape. The sensors used to measure temperature, PH, and dissolved oxygen are the DS18B20 sensor, 4502C pH sensor and DFRobot DO sensor. Temperature control is carried out by NodeMCU ESP32 using On-Off control and is equipped with a monitoring system via a smartphone. The control system in Aquascape works by maintaining the temperature at a set point of 22-25℃. If the temperature measurement results do not match the set point, the Peltier actuator will turn on to adjust the temperature to match the set point. This final project also uses HPL LEDs to help plants in Aquascape carry out photosynthesis. The results of this final project obtained the growth rate of Neon Tetra fish using a control system, namely the growth in length of the fish is 3.5 cm and the result of long growth without using a control system is 3.2 cm. It can be concluded that to increase the growth rate, a temperature control system can be used in Aquascape.

articleTitle: Portable Thermal Electricity Generator Using the Seebeck Effect of Peltier as an Alternative Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Indonesia is a country with abundant renewable energy resources including the solar energy. It is usually utilized by using solar panels as a means of conversion into electrical energy. Until now, solar panel technology has been developed to increase its efficiency, but although solar panels typically only have a 20-30% efficiency. Apart from solar panels, other components, such as the peltier element (thermo electric cooling), can be also utilized to convert solar energy into electrical energy. The solar energy used is the heat energy received by the roof of the house or other metal objects and then converted into electricity using a peltier. Peltier is known as an active solid state component that can transfer heat or cold for use by other devices. By providing a temperature difference on both sides, a peltier can generate a certain amount of electrical energy. This study aims to design and build a prototype of a thermal power generator using the Seebeck Peltier effect. Research and Development (R&D) is applied as a method to carry out all stages of the research including thermal power generator construction design, circuit design and analysis, and efficiency calculations.

articleTitle: Development of Heading Lock and Inverse Kinematics for an Unequal Degree Holonomic Transporter Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Internet of Things (IoT) technology is the optimal method for transporting products in a cyber-physical system (CPS) to accomplish Industry 4.0 solutions for the moving of mechatronic components in manufacturing facilities. Hence, the transporter robot communicates with all other manufacturing process tools in order to accept and execute any tasks. The omnidirectional mobile vehicle has proven that it performs better in crowded environments and confined aisles. The use of omnidirectional wheels provides simplifications compared to previous mobile robot architectures, which makes the proposed architecture more effective for mobility. Transport area restrictions in the manufacturing line require the development of a reliable and efficient robot transporter. To accomplish space efficiency, we propose a holonomic omnidirectional wheeled transporter robot platform with an unequal offset degree. The DC brushless motor position is adjusted to ensure the transporter robot is able to move in balance. The effectiveness was tested through experiments using a transporter robot platform prototype that generates a minimum error in heading and orientation about 2.2%.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Air Quality Measurement with Early Warning Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: A common problem in urban areas is the environmental issue of air pollution. Air pollution is the result of natural processes as well as human activities and activities that can lead to a decline in air quality. Although many people already know the risks of inhaling polluted air, it is often overlooked because there is still a lack of information about the real-time levels of inhaled compounds in the environment. Meanwhile, many effects from air pollution include difficulty breathing, coughing, asthma, emphysema to more severe illnesses. As the concentration of pollutants increases, the detection of concentrations of these compounds becomes important to prevent excess levels of hazardous compounds in the atmosphere. Therefore, it is necessary to measure and monitor the air quality that is equipped with an early warning system. In this study, a component validation test has been carried out where carbon dioxide levels measured by NDIR sensors are 99.33%, carbon monoxide levels measured by MQ-7 sensors with 98.85%, and DHT22 sensors have 99.72% accuracy for temperature variables and 98.85% for humidity variable. Online monitoring systems displayed on websites and offline monitoring systems using TFT LCD successfully display CO, CO₂, NO₂, temperature, and humidity. In addition, the initial warning system functions according to the parameters of each condition. The monitoring system that has been tested has performance with an average delay of 6 to 7 seconds between online and offline monitoring. This delay is due to an unfavorable internet connection that affects the process of sending data from hardware to databases

articleTitle: Design Of Sound And Light Simulator As Remote Laboratory To Support Distance Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Along with the times and technology, the need for technology and updates is also increasing. As part of the academic community, we are encouraged to help develop science and technology. One sector that is no less important is education. As a pillar of a country, the development of the quality of education requires assistance in terms of technology. So that a Remote Laboratory facility is needed that can provide understanding assistance to students by going directly to practice wherever and whenever. Remote Laboratory is a laboratory concept or research room that can be controlled via the internet. One of the tools used as a practicum tool in the Remote Laboratory is the Virtual Simulator. Where simulators are currently mostly not integrated with the use of the internet network. So that Virtual Simulator can be the answer to the above problems. The Virtual Simulator, which is designed using two quantities, namely sound and light, has good performance with integrated simulations using sensors and actuator settings from the website.

articleTitle: Predictive Scheduling System For Ball Mill Maintenance In Lead Paste Production Line Using Fuzzy Time Series Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Lead Acid Battery consists of two main components: the active material, Lead Paste, and the passive material, Grid. The production of Lead Paste involves several continuous processes, starting from the Lead Lump-making machine, Ball Mill, and Paste Mixing. Lead Powder is produced through the processing of Lead Lump in the Ball Mill, resulting in finer material due to collisions caused by hot airflow and Ball Mill rotation. Lead Lump usage data is crucial for analyzing performance and identifying Ball Mill issues when there is a decrease in performance due to abnormalities in the machine. However, currently, performance trend data is obtained by calculating the initial stock of lead ingots with lead oxide stored in a silo. This method is less accurate and leads to data gaps between the Lead Lump-making and pasting processes. This project goal is to provide supporting data for the necessary maintenance scheduling by the maintenance and engineering team at an Indonesian based battery manufacturer. Fuzzy time series method is chosen as the acquired data is time series data, and this method allows the use of real-time data. The project goal is to achieve the most accurate prediction by comparing several fuzzy time series methods and other prediction methods using RMSE and MAPE evaluation, with an emphasis on using the fuzzy time series method known as the Singh model, which has shown the highest prediction accuracy in previous research. The results show that the Fuzzy Time Series Model Singh provides the most accurate predictions compared to other methods, with RMSE and MAE values of 6% and 5% respectively. Therefore, this method is considered suitable as a decision support system for maintenance scheduling and performance improvement on ball mill.

articleTitle: Enhancing Autonomous Ground Vehicle Positioning and Navigation through Cascaded Multi-Sensor Integration
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Precise positioning and navigation are crucial for autonomous vehicles. An attempt to improve the preciseness of position and navigation measurements is made by using multiple sensors. This research proposes a multi-sensor integrated positioning and navigation system using cascaded data fusion for ground vehicles. The system consists of multiple Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) and a Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) receiver. An approach for fusing multiple redundant IMUs using a weighted average is proposed to obtain a virtual IMU. The virtual IMU and GNSS are integrated using a loosely-coupled approach. The system is tested on a ground vehicle with particle models. Two datasets are used: one collected on a straight road and another collected in a suburban area. The results show that the proposed method improves the preciseness of position and navigation measurement.

articleTitle: Transient Stability Analysis Due to Reconfiguration of Electrical Power System on Ship With Hybrid Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Based on data released through the Fourth International Maritime Organization (IMO) Study in 2020, tankers are the type of ship with the most fuel consumption. The use of a hybrid generator system by combining diesel and photovoltaic (PV) generators, moreover by reconfiguring the AC power system to DC is one of the considerations to overcome these problems. However, the use of such reconfiguration on ships, especially with the non-electric propulsion system is still rarely done so that research is still needed to investigate the transient stability of the system. This study aims to investigate the transient stability of the electrical distribution system in a ship when the conventional AC distribution is converter to the DC with the addition of the PV as the hybrid power sources with the diesel generators. This research is conducted based on a simulation with power system simulator software. The simulation is carried out based on a case study by applying a three-phase fault to a bus with large electrical load. The simulation results show that in the AC distribution system, the voltage and frequency responses are at a stable value according to the referenced standard. However, after reconfiguration into a DC distribution system, in some cases, the voltage response shows unstable response. To overcome this instability, stage 2 reconfiguration is done by dividing and arranging the bus into several parts to achieve a stable response. After stage 2 of reconfiguration, the unstable response was resolved.

articleTitle: Design of Robust Control System for delivery drones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: At this time, people prefer to shop online rather than shop directly to the store. Online shopping can be done through websites or e-commerce sites that provide buying and selling sites. Goods that are traded will be sent using a freight forwarder. This resulted in a buildup of consignment goods, so that goods that were important/emergency in nature were delayed for delivery. One of the efforts that can be made to overcome this problem is to make shipments by air. Modeling Quadcopter is done to overcome these problems. The modeling of Quadcopter is based on rotational, translational and angular kinematics. In its implementation, drones will experience interference, both interference from the system or interference from outside, for example, wind disturbance. Therefore, it is necessary to design a control system to maintain flight stability. In this research, a robust h-infinity control system will be applied. Where, the H-infinity control system is designed to ensure the stability and state of the system when disturbances occur, both internal and external disturbances. From the simulation results, it was found that the H-infinity control system was able to stabilize the drone’s motion during disturbances.

articleTitle: Image Detection of Seaweed, Seagrass, and Coral in Coastal and Underwater Marine Ecosystems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Marine ecosystem monitoring is crucial for understanding and preserving the health of coastal and underwater environments. This research presents an innovative approach to automatically detect and classify key components of marine ecosystems, namely seaweed, seagrass, and coral, from the images captured in coastal and underwater environments. We leverage the You Only Look Once (YOLO) object detection framework for its high-accuracy object recognition capabilities. To enhance the detection accuracy and improve the quality of input images, a combination of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and the Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization (CLAHE) algorithms is used during training. GANs generate synthetic images, expanding the diversity of training data. The CLAHE algorithm enhances the contrast and detail in both real and synthetic images, making the object detection process more robust. The integration of YOLO with GAN and CLAHE algorithms helps address challenges encountered in underwater imaging conditions, such as low visibility and changing lighting. Compared to the original YOLO-V7, it demonstrates an increase of 8% to 10% in detecting seaweed, seagrass, and coral using the new approach. This new approach showcases the potential for advancing the monitoring of coastal and underwater environments.

articleTitle: Integration of Centralized Fingerprint Biometric Authentication To Prevent Room Access Violations Using RBAC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Area and room access management is very important for company security. Prevent security issues related to confidentiality, integrity, and economics. Security system as a food defense effort against food fraud and bio vigilance, its common problems: violation of room access by employees or external parties. This research used the role-based access control (RBAC) method with fingerprint biometric authentication, authorized security management and control software monitors breaches in real-time. BioLite N2 was installed on the room door and connected to the server via a distributed access control system. Trial and testing was done includes system functionality, biometric reading speed, role access, false acceptance rate (FAR), false rejection rate (FRR), and monitoring. Company areas are only accessed based on granted authority. Our system strengthens food defense and work as early detection of threats.

articleTitle: A Microgrid-Based Power Quality Enhancer for Sustainable Energy Using Hybrid Active Power Filter Control
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The stability of the system may be impacted by the significant problem of the rise of nonlinear load. Deep neuro Fuzzy logic control is used to solve the difficult problem of controller parameter tuning and to demonstrate the system's stability using Clarke's stability function, and for optimizing sensing harmonic source this study use FFT lag-1 to reduce harmonics source. The research study will concentrate on an enhanced current technique that uses a fuzzy interface in conjunction with an HAPF (Hybrid Active Power Filter) and is applied to combination linear load with non-linear load. Finally, a comparison of two more methods is made the latter approach outperforms the standard active power filter. These other methods include a hybrid filter with Deep Neuro Fuzzy Logic. The same model was simulated in IEEE std-519-1992 under both perfect and distorted supply conditions, and it was found that the latter configuration yielded better results than the former.

articleTitle: Design And Implementation Of A PID Control System On A UAV Tracker Antenna
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Antennas are essential components in communication systems, serving as both transmitters and receivers. Their efficient operation depends on precise alignment with the strongest signal source, facilitated by tracker antennas. A recent research study focused on enhancing the responsiveness of these tracker antennas. By manually inputting PID (Proportional-Integral-Derivative) values for direction control, the study achieved notable improvements.The results demonstrated that by fine-tuning PID values, particularly setting Kp=5, Ki=0.21812, and Kd=12, and targeting an angle of 90°, the response time was reduced to 1.2 seconds with an overshoot of 28.8% and 1.6 seconds of oscillation. This optimized control mechanism significantly improved antenna direction accuracy, aligning it with the desired setpoint. Furthermore, the importance of antenna alignment and polarization matching in communication systems was emphasized. Ensuring alignment between the receiving antenna's polarization and the incoming wave polarization is crucial for maintaining a strong signal reception power level. This alignment enables accurate tracking of antenna positions, supporting real-time GPS data communication. Additionally, the study involving horizontal azimuth angle measurements with tracker antennas demonstrated their capability to transmit real-time data from multiple positions, achieving 360° horizontal azimuth angles, along with varying elevations. These precise measurements play a vital role in object monitoring and effective communication.

articleTitle: Voltage Regulation of a Three-Phase PV-Connected Inverter Using LMI-Based Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This paper lays out a systematic control design for a three-phase PV-connected inverter with an output LC-filter. It mainly focuses on the inverter side to provide a well-regulated three-phase voltage, assuming that the DC voltage side is stable by using the DC-DC converter. This proposed controller is based on state feedback control with integral action to provide closed-loop stability to the system with zero steady-state error. To shorten the settling time to the steady state of the output three-phase voltage, the set of state feedback gain and integral gain is determined by solving an optimization problem using a linear matrix inequality approach. In addition, this control method is employed using a dq-rotating reference frame so that the controller can be driven on DC quantities. The space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) is also considered in this proposed inverter, using the control input obtained by the computed optimal gain to trigger the IGBT switches of the three-phase inverter. To verify the efficacy of this proposed PV-connected inverter, simulations are conducted using MATLAB to compute the optimal gain and PSIM to implement the control algorithm. To further verify the performance of this proposed controller, a comparison with the existing PI control method is studied in the simulation results. The experiment was conducted with the TMS320F28335 digital signal processor together with the inverter prototype.

articleTitle: Analysis of success implementation of information systems Maintenance BTS Tower Telecommunication based WEB (Case Study PT Tekno Infrastruktur Sukses)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: PT Tekno Infrastruktur Sukses is a company that operates in the field of Base Transceiver Station (BTS) telecommunications tower maintenance services. In carrying out its duties, PT Tekno Infrastruktur Sukses is assisted by a system called Trast Tislink. Since this system was created in 2018, no analysis has been carried out regarding the impacts and benefits obtained from this system. The analysis carried out in this research is an effort to determine the condition and use of the Trast Tislink system. The aim of this research is to analyze the implementation of the BTS telecommunications tower maintenance information system at PT Tekno Infrastruktur Sukses using the HOT-Fit method. The respondents in this research were users of the Trast Tislink system, totaling 100 respondents. The data processing technique used in this research is SEM – PLS using SmartPLS 4.0 software. The research results show that the success of implementing the Trast Tislink system is at the level of 45.6% and is included in the moderate or quite strong category, but it cannot be said to be successful. Factors that influence the analysis of the success of system implementation using the HOT-Fit model are from the human aspect; user satisfaction influences the benefits and use of the system. From the organizational aspect, the organizational environment influences the benefits and the organizational structure influences user satisfaction, while in the technological aspect, system quality, information quality and service quality influence user satisfaction, and system quality has no influence on system users, and from the net benefit or benefit. What is obtained is that you can find out the variables and factors that influence the success or failure of implementing this system and that system developers can upgrade the system to a better one in the future.

articleTitle: Natural Language Processing for Intelligence Assistive Interface Development "LihatIN"
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Sight is one of the most important senses used by everyone in this world to interact with various objects and people in the real world. It is known that globally there are 2.2 billion people who have visual impairment. This number is predicted by Lancet Global Health (LGH) to continue to triple by 2050. One of the common problems often experienced by blind people is when carrying out mobilization activities. We often encounter incidents such as getting lost in blind people in everyday life. Based on these problems, a tool was created for blind people using smartphones, namely "SeeIN" which is a digital-based application for blind people. The advantage of this application is that it can recognize surrounding conditions by directing the camera in the direction that blind people want to know. This application is able to replace the role of the eyes in seeing objects around them and helps mobilize to go somewhere.

articleTitle: Design of a Bus Payment System Using Near-Field Communication (NFC)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In Cambodia, the populace values convenience, speed, and cost-effectiveness when it comes to transportation. The transition from cycling to bus travel could potentially alleviate traffic congestion. However, the existing payment system, which relies on deposit boxes, can cause delays. Developers implementing a Near Field Communication (NFC) payment system must first understand the processes and components involved. The development of this system can be broadly divided into three stages: Hardware Development, Software Development, and Block Diagram and Coding. The Hardware Development stage involves selecting and setting up the necessary hardware components. This includes the NFC reader and the cards (NFC, Smart Card, and Tag Card). The Software Development stage entails creating software interacting with the hardware to process payments. This could involve setting up a database to store payment information, developing an interface for users to interact with, and implementing security measures to protect user data. The Block Diagram and Coding stage involves creating a block diagram to visualize the system’s operation and writing the code that will control the system. An experiment involving multiple NFC, Smart Card, and Tag Card scans was conducted to gather data. The NFC system demonstrated optimal performance at a distance of 3.5cm. The Smart Card system performed best from 2.5cm to 3cm. The Tag Card system had optimal performance at a distance of 1.5cm. Among these three types of cards, NFC was found to have the longest scanning distance for payments. This research provides valuable insights into developing an efficient NFC-based payment system for buses in Cambodia, potentially revolutionizing public transportation in the region.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Summarization Methods for Skin Care Product Reviews: A Study on BERT, BART, and T5 Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The growth of the skin care industry is driving consumers to look for product review information. The skincare product currently widely used by women and men is facial wash products. On the Female Daily website, the most frequently purchased facial wash products are Cetaphil products. With so many purchases of this product, potential buyers want to try the product by reading the reviews first. However, the large number of reviews is a barrier to accessing relevant information. Therefore, effectively summarizing reviews can solve this problem by presenting key information more concisely and digestibly. This study aims to evaluate the effectiveness of three different summary methods, namely BERT, BART, and T5, in summarizing skin care product reviews. The stages in these three models are explained in detail. Evaluation results using the ROUGE Score method with the Cetaphil facial wash product review dataset show that the BART model consistently has a higher average ROUGE Score than the BERT and T5 models. Specifically, the BART model achieved an average ROUGE-1 of 0.87718, ROUGE-2 of 0.80689, and ROUGE-L of 0.87688, while the BERT model achieved an average ROUGE-1 of 0.84591, ROUGE-2 of 0.77585, and ROUGE- L is 0.84479, and model T5 has an average ROUGE-1 of 0.74995, ROUGE-2 of 0.70048, and ROUGE-L of 0.73023. These results suggest that the generative approach implemented by BART is more effective in addressing the diversity and complexity of skin care product reviews. Therefore, using the BART model is a better choice for producing skin care product review summaries that are more informative and useful for consumers. In the future, these findings may contribute to developing more sophisticated product review summary systems.

articleTitle: Ransomware Transaction Detection on the Blockchain with the TabNet Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Ransomware is malicious software that encrypts a victim’s data, restricting their access and demanding a cryptocurrency ransom, typically in Bitcoin, for data release. The inherent privacy and intricate blockchain transaction process create challenges distinguishing between legitimate and ransom transactions. Consequently, a robust detection method is essential. Our approach involves a detection technique that analyzes various transaction features, including processed transactions, Bitcoin addresses, transaction weights, loops, lengths, counts, neighbors, years, and days. Leveraging the TabNet deep learning model and data from January 2009 to December 2018, our method outperforms traditional machine learning techniques, achieving a superior recall rate (0.61) and F1 Score (0.55) compared to decision trees’ 0.50 for both recall and F1 Score.

articleTitle: Single-board Computer for Rural Traffic Counting System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: A rural traffic counting system was implemented using single-board computer paired with laser photodiodes. The system locally records the timestamp, length, and velocity of passing vehicles on a two-lane road. The system robustly worked with approximately 92% accuracy based on a one-day field test conducted in Nijo District, Masuda Municipality, Shimane Prefecture, Japan. The system offers several advantages over conventional road surface-bound vehicle detectors and traffic video surveillance pipelines, including mobile setup, absence of road obstruction, and higher possible data throughput. Furthermore, the system could be improved using data fusion with additional sensors and network connectivity between sensor nodes. The system provides an alternative for rural traffic counting, which could otherwise be unreliable, expensive, and difficult to update.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the School Library Website Use Using Human Organization Technology Fit (Hot-Fit) Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In this study an evaluation of the website-based school library information system was done. The method is used in this study was Human Organization-Technology fit (Hot-Fit) method. The focus of this study was in terms of use, organization, technology and application benefits according to user needs. The stages of this research were problem identification, determining research respondents, creating questionnaires using hot-fit, distributing questionnaires, processing data, compiling results and analyzing them. The results show that there were 4 accepted hypotheses and 6 rejected hypotheses with details of t-statistics greater than 1.96, namely service quality affects system use with a t-statistic value of 2.808, system quality affects user satisfaction with a value t-statistic 1.975, system use has an effect on net benefits with a t-statistic value of 2.085, and organizational structure has an effect on net benefits with a t-statistic value of 3.317.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection using Wide Tuned Convolutional Neural Network on IoT Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) traffic is growing as a result of the enormous number of IoT devices. Intrusion detection systems (IDS) are necessary for detecting network threats. As a solution to the challenges, this research proposes a deep learning-based intrusion detection approach. A Wide Tuned Convolutional Neural Network (WTCNN) is designed to identify an attack in the real-time traffic of an IoT network environment. Data preprocessing and hyperparameter tuning are involved to achieve better performance. Based on result, the proposed method could achieve 0.99 of accuracy, 0.019 of loss, and 0.99 recall, precision, and F1 score. This proposed method gets the best result compared to existing algorithms.

articleTitle: Temperature Analysis of Fan-Shaped Contaminated Porcelain Insulators Using Thermal Imaging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Insulators have a central role in preventing disturbances in the electricity distribution system, such as phase-to-ground short circuits that can occur. Fan-shaped contamination is one of the problems that often occurs in insulators. This type of contamination is usually caused by rainwater or dew that carries dust, dirt, or salt and then dries on the insulator to form a fan-shaped pattern on the insulator surface. Non-Soluble Material Deposit Density (NSDD) and Equivalent Salt Deposit Density (ESDD) are two important parameters used to measure the level of contamination of an insulator. Temperature rise in a contaminated insulator is a potentially dangerous situation and can increase the risk of failure in electrical systems. Therefore, it is important to have a reliable monitoring system to accurately detect temperature changes. This research uses the thermal camera detection method to understand the behavior of insulators and the effect of contamination on the temperature of porcelain insulators. Tests of applying 20 kV voltage and taking thermal images on contaminated insulators were carried out after the conditioning process of the test chamber with 90 percent humidity. From the test results of each insulator, 6 thermal images and temperature trend values based on different times. The conclusion of the study shows that the use of thermal cameras is effective in detecting temperature changes in contaminated insulators. This is important for preventing the risk of failure in electrical systems and enabling timely preventive action.

articleTitle: Smart Water Meter Based on LoRA Communication Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Water is an essential part of life. Indonesia operates a state-run drinking water company and distributes water through manual water meters at customer locations. Due to the fact that the recording process still relies on human labor, billing and usage are often out of sync. The objective of this study is to propose a smart water meter that communicates using LoRA technology. In contrast to the previous system, this system sends the bill recording process to the server automatically every day. Also, this smart water meter has a battery, so it will automatically operate if there is a power outage. According to the results of this study, LoRA can successfully send smart water meter data up to 98 percent with varying delay variations and includes 4 nodes.

articleTitle: Design Of Light Intensity and Soil Moisture Control System to Optimize Lettuce Growth Indoors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Indoor home gardening is an activity that is currently widely practiced in urban areas. This is due to the lack of land in urban areas so that many people in urban areas do farming activities with minimum space. Plants that are grown indoors certainly have many variables that need to be maintained such as sunlight and water needs. Therefore, in this final project, a system to control soil moisture and light intensity will be designed. The light intensity control system is done by controlling the dim light of the LED strip using an automatic dimmer. Meanwhile, the soil moisture control system will use a pump to do automatic watering and a fan to dry the soil that is too wet. From the results of the research conducted, the average percentage error for the soil moisture sensor is 4.167% and the accuracy is 95.833%. As for the light intensity sensor, the error is 3.6% and the accuracy is 96.4%.

articleTitle: 3D Simulation Combustion Characteristics Of EFB Biomass Co-Firing With Low Rank Coal In Pulverized Coal Boiler
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Climate change has received a lot of attention due to high emissions in the energy sector from coal-dependent generators, but the solution that can be done to overcome this is the co-firing method through CFD simulation with a discrete phase model (DPM) carried out by adding EFB biomass in a ratio 5% and 95% LRC coal are injected into the boiler combustion furnace. The research was carried out on a PC boiler with a generation capacity of 315Mwe. The research results show that the addition of EFB biomass to coal combustion causes changes in the calorific value which has an impact on the high temperature of the combustion process. However, it has a good impact from the operational side of burning coal particles.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Effect of Go-food on Consumptive Behaviour
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This study investigates the impact of Go-Food on consumptive behavior among consumers in Surabaya, Indonesia. Using a descriptive quantitative approach, the study examines the relationship between Go-Food usage and consumptive behavior. The research was conducted at the Institute of Technology Sepuluh Nopember (ITS) with a sample of 40 students. Our findings suggest that there is a strong relationship between Go-Food usage and consumer behavior, with 75% of respondents reporting increased consumption of food and beverages and also the majority of satisfaction on the service. This study provides valuable insights into the effects of food delivery services on consumer behavior.

articleTitle: Design of Alarm and Shutdown System Simulating CO2 Gas Leakage at SARASSORA Plant Based on Safety Instrumented System Concept
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Gas leak detection is important because it can cause something fatal like an explosion, even worse gas is a compound that cannot be seen by the human eye directly. But not many tools related to CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas has a system that can detect a gas leak either tested or caused by failure of the tool that will provide an indicator or marker in the form of an alarm and flow closure action with a safety instrumented system (SIS). In addition, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas is a gas that is harmful to human health. Therefore, designing a device that can detect the presence of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas can be a focus. So a tool is proposed that can detect CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas leaks which can also be used as a practicum or simulation prop. The tool will simulate the occurrence of a gas leak by opening a valve that indicates as if a gas leak has occurred. The results of the detection will be issued on an alarm indicating that there is a CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> gas leak. This tool uses the same and identical 2 sensors to minimize the occurrence of false alarms in line with the safety instrumented function (SIF) with a 2oo2 configuration that will work when only the two sensors get identical readings. In addition to the alarm and SIS indicators that are output, the tests carried out produce data that this sensor has an optimal range value of 325 to 1000 ppm. In addition, in this test, the results of the actuators, both alarms and shutdown valves, can work according to the system made.

articleTitle: Possibility of hydrogen gas as the main fuel for diesel engines: A review
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The world has imposed strict regulations on carbon emissions to avoid rising global air temperatures which could harm human health. Diesel dual fuel with the addition or replacement of hydrogen gas is a solution to reduce carbon emissions from the transportation sector. The target of dual fuel mode in diesel engines is to reduce carbon emissions. However, the threat of knocking cannot be avoided because the physical of hydrogen gas is different from diesel fuel. Several studies stated that the reduction in carbon emissions was directly proportional to the increase in hydrogen gas in the combustion chamber. Increasing hydrogen gas levels in the combustion chamber should not be accompanied by an increasing engine load because it could cause knocking. A hundred percent replacement of diesel with hydrogen gas can be realized in diesel engines with correct predictions.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Voltage Drop on Low Voltage Direct Current Power System on Ship with Hybrid Power Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Indonesia has ratified the Paris Agreement, meaning that the country must prioritize efforts to reduce Green House Gases by using New and Renewable Energy. In marine engineering scope, the electrical system with a hybrid generator and photovoltaic sources, combined with direct current (DC) distribution system on ship is one of the feasible solutions. While the effectivity in high voltage DC system has been frequently mentioned, the effectiveness of low voltage DC has not been studied. One of the necessary analyzes the effectiveness of the distribution of electricity is a voltage drop analysis. The research process conducted by modeling single-line diagrams of the AC and DC distribution systems of hybrid sources, and voltage drop simulations were performed using power analysis simulation software. The voltage drop value on the AC and DC distribution of the four ship operating conditions, namely sailing, loading-unloading, leaving/arriving and at port are compared. Based on the voltage drop data obtained, all of the values are fulfilling the IEC standard, which is 5%. The value of the DC distribution voltage drop has a smaller value than the AC distribution. In AC distribution, the largest bus voltage drop in sailing conditions is 1.55%. In DC distribution, the largest bus voltage drop is is 1.41%.

articleTitle: Lane Detection System Based on Canny Method for Driving Assistance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: A development of lane detection system (LDS) is presented to assist the driver to keep the vehicle in the lane. This development concerns the LDS software. It is done by implementing an image-processing technique known as the Canny method. The Canny method is to detect lines on the road as the lane borders, by extracting image data. The development includes several steps: preprocessing, image segmentation, edge detection, filtering, Hough transformation, and linear regression. A single still image is used as the basis in developing the LDS. There after, the performance of LDS is evaluated through a simulation to detect the lane using a driving video. The result shows that the LDS was able to detect the road lane along the vehicle movement.

articleTitle: Design of Energy Management System on Hybrid Fuel Cell Battery System for Electric Trains
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Train is one of the most frequently used transportations in Indonesia. Indonesia is currently dominated by non-electrified lines and the trains used on these lines are diesel-based locomotives and diesel-based commuter trains which are less environmentally friendly. The electric-based commuter train (KRL) itself still has a limited coverage area. Electric vehicles (EVs) are becoming known because they are in line with the goals of the Paris Agreement, which is to push down the increase in the earth's temperature. Battery electric vehicles (BEVs) and fuel cell vehicles (FCVs) are in high demand for research and have the potential to be hybridized to drive drivetrains of trains because fuel cells have high energy density but low in power density. However combining and determining the size of these various energies is a challenge in the development of hybrid traction systems. The sharing of energy from fuel cells and batteries in an electric train still requires further research. Based on the importance of the transition from fossil fuels to renewable energy, as well as trains which are important transportation for the community, it is necessary to develop a system that includes energy management (Energy Management System, EMS) for a hybrid system with a combination of these power sources. Based on the simulation, EMS is able to keep the power balance, control the power output from fuel cell and battery as the power source of electric trains and control the charging and discharging process of the battery.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Temperature Control System in Cow's Milk Yoghurt Fermenter for Optimization of the Growth of Lactobacilus Bulgaricus Bacteria
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Indonesia currently has a population of 578,579 dairy cows with a production of 107,481 thousand liters of fresh milk per year. It is known that people prefer to consume processed cow products compared to fresh milk because they have the preferred variant and have a longer storage time. However, to process yoghurt requires a fermentation process which requires quite a long time and faces problems in temperature control. Therefore, the proposed fermenter prototype will help improve the quality and efficiency of yoghurt production with a temperature control and monitoring system that is integrated with a smartphone. Based on these problems, this study aims to create a fermenter prototype with a temperature control system and monitoring bacterial growth and development that is integrated with a smartphone to increase the efficiency of yoghurt production in Indonesia. This journal uses ESP32 as a microcontroller to send data to the internet, RTD PT-100 is used to read temperature and sensor PH-4502C is used to monitor pH. The method of testing the system by varying the temperature range in making yoghurt, and the test results obtained in the most optimal temperature range variation at 38-39°C the final pH value is 4.14 and the control system is able to maintain the temperature range value for an average of 15 minutes.

articleTitle: Design and Construction of Photovoltaic Preventive Maintenance Robotic for Roof-Top PLTS Installation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The decrease in irradiance level can be caused by dust and animal droppings adhering to the surface of the solar panel module. If the solar panel module is not cleaned regularly, environmental dust will accumulate on the surface of the solar panel module. Because of this dust, solar panels cannot work optimally. Solar panels will work optimally at a temperature of 25°C. The greater the temperature of the solar panel will have an impact on the power generated by the solar panel. Based on some of the existing reviews, in this Final Project a PLC-based automatic cleaning tool is designed with a cleaning method using pressurized water spray to reduce the temperature of solar panels and clean adhering dirt. The system that was initiated is to use 2 control modes using a PLC to be able to operate the system and use water as a cleaner. The highest power of the motor in this system is 4.44 Watt. With a speed of 30 RPM, the cleaning kit in 1x cleaning loop takes 2.24 minutes. The flow rate used is 14.33 m/s and the pressure is 46 PSI. With this flow rate, this technology is able to clean dust for 2.24 minutes or 1x loop, clean sawdust for 2.24 minutes or 1x loop, clean animal waste (rats) for 4.48 minutes or 2x loops and clean oil /oil for 8.96 minutes or 4x loops. The results of the visual test using the quantitative method showed that 53.6% of the assessors chose the cleaning result, which was very clean. And as many as 46.4% of assessors chose the cleaning result which was quite clean. Nobody chooses unclean. Thus, this cleaning technology is effective in cleaning dust and dirt attached to solar panels. The results of the power output test showed that solar panels using cleaning technology (array 1) increased the output power. The temperature of the array 1 solar panel is also lower than that of the array 2 solar panel.

articleTitle: Experimental Modeling of Hydraulic Characteristics in Stiling Basin USBR Type III
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The paper presents the hydraulic performance on the USBR Type III Stilling Basin Model. The USBR stilling basin type III is widely used to construct reservoirs with low hydrostatic pressure and discharge rates. The hydraulic characteristics, like possible jump types, pressure regimes, and forces acting on the sill, aren’t considered. This research aimed to determine the effect of tailwater conditions on water level (y1 and y2), length of the basin (Lj), Froude number (Fr), critical depth (yc), and the effectivity of dissipation energy (ΔE). The results of this study show that the average energy dissipation ratio of the USBR Type III Stilling Basin without the influence of Tailwater is 87.45%, while the efficiency is 12.55%. The average energy dissipation ratio of the USBR Type III Stilling Basin with the influence of Tailwater is 69.47%, while the efficiency is 30.53%. The water level elevation without Tailwater is lower than that using Tailwater conditions. With a Froude Numbers (Fr2) value of 0.22 (<1), the flow condition with Tailwater is subcritical flow.

articleTitle: Line Tracking Algorithm Based on Computer Vision Leveraging Stereo Camera to Support Decision of Automated Guided Vehicle Navigation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: An Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) is a specialized vehicle capable of autonomous movement and performing specific tasks. AGVs are commonly utilized in the warehouse area to transport some materials from one location to another. Some research have been conducted on the development of AGV, but there are still some problems such as inability to detect the changing line ahead of the AGV platform and the effect of light illumination that can obscure the guide lines trajectory. To overcome these issues,this research has developed an alternative line tracking algorithm based on the contour-based search method, leveraging a stereo camera. This algorithm was tested on an AGV system consisting of ZED 2i stereo camera, Jetson Xavier NX computing unit and Jetracer platform. Experiments were done by varying the Jetracer speed from 30 to 65 cm/s to evaluate the performance of the algorithm. According to the experimental results, the Jetracer platform is able to follow the guide line path with small average distance bias ranging from 3.85 - 9.12 cm from the actual trajectory as reference data. As a result, this experiment indicates that the developed line tracking algorithm is suitable for effective operation within the low to medium speed range.

articleTitle: The Application of Artificial Neural Network (ANN) for Meat Classification Based on Near Infrared (NIR) Data Spectroscopy
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Research has been conducted on the classification of different types of meat using Near Infrared (NIR) spectroscopy method. This research uses 6 types of meat, namely, beef, chicken, lamb, chicken liver, ear mushrooms (A. Auriculla), and oyster mushrooms (P. Ostretatus). The input data used to design the ANN (Artificial Neural Network) architecture is the wavelength and transmittance intensity of each sample type. ANN architecture was designed by creating 1 input layer, 8 hidden layers, and 1 output layer and getting the best results. The ANN classifies the different types of meat so that meat differentiation can be done. Classification gives an accuracy value 72.38% with an epoch of 500. This result is good to be able for distinguish and predict different types of meat. The result shows that ANN can contribute with high accuracy and precision for NIR spectroscopy data.

articleTitle: Electricity Generating System by Using Stirling Engine integrated with Internet of Things (IoT)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The utilization of renewable energy sources in accordance with the purpose or want to maximize the potential of renewable energy. The fact is that the underlying concept of the law of conservation of energy. One of the developments of alternative energy is the utilization of combustion as a source of electrical energy with technology that principle to directly convert heat energy into electrical energy by using Stirling engine. The Stirling engine is a type of combustion outside with a closed cycle which converts the heat energy into energy of motion using air or gas as the working fluid. In this research, the mini plant of Stirling engine was created and connected to the generator to produce electricity. From the test results, the Stirling engine has 2375 rpm, the machine can rotate with a warmup at the hot cylinder when it reaches a temperature of 51 C and to the power produced can reach 1.32 watt. The rotation speed of the flywheel is affected by temperature increase, system and monitoring using the app blynk as IoT in this system. This system is integrated with Internet of Things (IoT) as monitoring the result of the temperature, angular velocity, and power.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Four Cables Suspended Cable-driven Parallel Robot for Pendulum Batik Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This study researches the fusion of Indonesian traditional batik art with modernity called the Batik Pendulum. A machine based on Cable-Driven Parallel Robot (CDPR) architecture has been developed to automate the process of Batik Pendulum drawing. The suspended CDPR design uses four cables to provide flexibility and space efficiency. An artist may draw rough pendulum patterns utilizing a tablet as a human interface, which are then coded into coordinate-based code and sent to a microcontroller. The microcontroller drives four stepper motors to synchronize the length of the cables. Therefore, the platform carrying the wax can be moved to create the desired batik patterns. The machine was tested by dripping the paint on the fabric along the test path to validate the accuracy of the patterns. The Mean Absolute Percentage Error test results for the x, y, and radius axes were 1.63%, 1.95%, and 6.33%, while the maximum error values in the movement of the x, y, and radius axes were 8.64, 18.3, and 24.08 mm. This research represents a significant step in preserving Indonesia's cultural heritage while embracing contemporary creativity.

articleTitle: Optimized Artificial Potential Fields for Obstacle Avoidance of Unmanned Aerial Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The obstacle avoidance method for unmanned aerial vehicles is presented in this paper. Obstacle avoidance is a crucial ability necessary in the operation of autonomous vehicles when they are required to follow a path that passes obstacles. The artificial potential field (APF) algorithm is a path-planning algorithm developed in robotics that allows the avoidance of static obstacles. In this paper, the optimized APF has been applied. The optimized APF has an advantage over the classic APF, namely, avoiding local minima and unreached targets. It can be shown that the algorithm has been successfully applied in simulation to perform obstacle avoidance in several scenarios.

articleTitle: Empowering Library Attendance System with IoT-Enabled Student ID Cards
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In an era driven by digital transformation, the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technology into educational institutions has become paramount for optimizing operations and enhancing user experiences. By enhancing traditional barcode identifiers with IoT capabilities, we create a system that not only streamlines attendance tracking but also provides real-time data, valuable user insights, and enhanced security measures. This study proposes an IoT-based library attendance system that utilizes barcode technology on student ID cards. The system aims to improve attendance tracking, optimize resource allocation, and enhance user experiences in college libraries. The hardware components of the system consist of Raspberry Pi 3 and barcode scanners, while the software system includes front-end and back-end applications. The research results demonstrate a prototype of the assembled hardware and the user interface of the software system. The proposed system offers advantages such as efficiency, real-time data, enhanced security, and improved user experiences. The IoT-based library attendance system has been successfully developed and can be used by users to record their visits to the library. The system includes features to manage program data, update user information, and generate visit reports. The system is designed to be efficient and effective for librarians in managing visits and allocating their time for other tasks.

articleTitle: Monitoring And Control System for pH and Temperature of Water Quality on The Vertical Mud Crab Cultivation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)

authors.preferredName: Ir. I Putu Eka Widya Pratama

abstract: The success parameters of mud crab cultivation can be seen from the temperature, pH, and ammonia levels contained in the water. Basically the monitoring process for the 3 parameters mentioned above is done manually. Therefore, in this final project, a control and monitoring system will be created with parameters of temperature, pH, and ammonia levels to help cultivators to create an effective and efficient system. The water quality values are as follows, temperature with an optimum value of 29 °C and with a range of 25-35 °C, with an optimum value of 25 ppt and with 20-28 ppt, pH with an optimum value of 7 and with a range of 7-8 and for an optimum value of ammonia in mud crab 0.25 ppm. At the time of making the tool, sensor validation and system performance testing were carried out in controlling the parameters of temperature, pH, and ammonia levels. The on-off control system is used in the system to activate the relay so that the pump and heater can be controlled according to the set-point that has been input in the application.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Consumption for Electrical Motor on Automatic Micro Electric Vehicle (MEVi)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The rapid evolution of electric vehicle (EV) technology emphasizes the need for eco-friendly solutions to fight climate change and promote zero-emission. And suitable for the transportation on the large cities with high levels of mobility. This study explores the features and effectiveness of the Micro Electric Vehicle (MEVi) prototype based on motor usage of the accessible power source. The vehicle is powered by a 750 W/1HP brushless DC (BLDC) motor and a 48V 41.6Ah LI-ion battery source. A programmable controller is utilized in regulating the operation of the electric motor. The tests were carried out at two varying speed modes, with and without load operation on the track. Power consumption at 72 Watts and 119 Watts was achieved during the no-load experiment, while the loaded experiments yielded 182 and 414 watts respectively. Programmable settings are utilized with a controller to regulate the electric motor's operations. Throughout the test, the power efficiency achieved an average percentage of 70% when the motor was without a load and 15% under load testing.

articleTitle: Analysis of Legislative Candidate’s Motivation and Target in General Election 2019 Using Author-Topic Model and Node2vec
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Every legislative candidate registered for the 2019 General Election must fill out a variety of information, including their electoral district, name, place of birth, party, occupation, status, and goals. It is crucial for motivation and goals to be made public. As a result, we use the Author-Topic Model and Node2vec to evaluate and display the themes modeling in the 2019 General Election data. Only 5.084 of the 36.889 legislative candidate records collected through data crawling from 16 parties include motive and target. While the objective topic modeling creates themes like the role of a legislative member, local development, and national movement, the motivation topic modeling generates topics like education, economics, and welfare. Several parties share similar topics in their target and motivations.

articleTitle: Efficiency Evaluation of a dual-inverter supplied open-end three-phase 5 Hp Induction motor drives
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This paper discusses efficiency of Variable Speed Drive (VSD) of dual-inverter fed a three-phase 5 Hp open-end winding induction motor. The motor is controlled using equivalent Space Vector Carrier Based PWM. VSD System is modelled using Matlab/Simulink meanwhile inverter and motor are modelled using Simscape Blockset. Simulation result shows that efficiency VSD using dual-inverter is significantly improved in comparison with VSD using two-level inverter. At modulation indices 0.15 – 1.15, efficiency of the system using two-level inverter is in the range of 20% - 82% which is improved by 36% to 97% for the system fed by dual Inverter at full Load (20 N-m). The improvement of efficiency of VSD system with dual-inverter is caused by improvement of inverter efficiency by 76%-98%, compared with efficiency of two-level inverter (44%-93%) while efficiency of motor is relatively the same in the range of 45% to 89% for both inverter structures under investigation. Improvement of efficiency is in line with improvement of quality of inverter output voltage of the dual-inverter over the two-level inverter. Furthermore, it is also found that the efficiency of system is reduced by the reduction of motor load. At very low load, the reactive power (Q) becomes higher than the active power (P), which means the power factor of system become very low (less than 0.5)

articleTitle: Prototype of Plant Advisor Based on Soil Condition Using Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In measuring the level of soil fertility, it can be done by measuring several parameters. The parameters used as characteristics in measuring soil fertility are pH, temperature, and moisture. Some measuring instruments to determine these parameters already have accurate values. However, these measuring instruments still do not have a data logger system to store the measurement results. So, a design of pH, temperature, and humidity parameter measurement system with data logger was made. This system is portable by using E201C sensor as a pH measurement tool and DS18B20 sensor as a temperature measurement tool. Also, capacitive soil moisture sensor is used to measure humidity. In addition, in testing each sensor component, the average error value on each sensor is no more than 5% with an accuracy of more than 95%. Then, the calculation of the static characteristic value of each sensor component also has accurate results. This test is carried out with several steps adjusted to the media used, namely soil. In the data logger test, the three sensors have taken readings well and the data can be stored on an SD card. In addition, monitoring measurements can be seen directly on the LCD screen as well as on the device with Blynk. The display that has been given shows the value of pH, temperature, and humidity measurements that have stabilized and given the results of plant recommendations for planting according to soil conditions. In testing the system in the field, the measurement values of the three parameters showed stability at any time for three days. The crop recommendations given were corn, melon, watermelon, and cantaloupe. The results of these recommendations have been confirmed by the partners that these plants have been and are currently planted on the land.

articleTitle: Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Images based on Interpolation Compression and Bits Distribution
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Securing online data storage is paramount in the modern digital age, particularly when dealing with sensitive information. Reversible Data Hiding in Encrypted Images (RDHEI) emerges as a highly promising technological advancement that permits embedding confidential data within encrypted images. This study focuses on developing an RDHEI algorithm employing the interpolation method and bit distribution. Through the amalgamation of multiple interpolation algorithms, a comparative analysis is conducted to identify the optimal combination. This approach leverages interpolation for dimensional reduction within the image, thereby maximizing its storage capacity. Furthermore, the concealed data and the image can be restored to their original version utilizing the reverse algorithm. Experimental results demonstrated that linear interpolation and dimensional restoration using Lanczos interpolation yields the most favorable outcomes. These results showed significant achievements in an Embedding Rate (ER) score of up to 5,929 bits per pixel (bpp), a Structure Similarity Index (SSIM) score of 0.971, and a Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR) score of 38.722 dB. These results indicate that our proposed RDHEI algorithm can be a practical approach for data hiding.

articleTitle: Forecasting average room rate using k-nearest neighbor at Hotel S
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In managing a hospitality business, it takes a lot of data and analysis to make the right decisions. One important indicator in assessing the performance of a hotel is the Average Room Rate (ARR) which shows the average price of rooms sold by the hotel in a certain period. From the ARR data obtained, it can make a picture of the future regarding expansion to increase the value of ARR in the future. In this study, ARR forecasting was carried out for Hotel S using the k-nearest neighbor (k-NN) method. The dataset used in this study is in the form of room sold out, room revenue, and average room rate at Hotel S from April 2018 to June 2023. The simulation was carried out by dividing the data into training data and testing data with a ratio of 70:30 and 80:20, and the selection of k-values are 3 to 7. The forecasting results that have been carried out using k-NN for split data 70%:30% produce an optimal RMSE of 6,335 at k-values is 3. The forecasting results that have been carried out using k-NN for 80%:20% data split produce an optimal RMSE of 7,452 at k-values is 5. From this comparison, the results of forecasting ARR using k-NN obtained the best RMSE of 6,335. The results of this study can be used by Hotel S in determining the price of various types of rooms that are appropriate and expected to provide benefits for management.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation in Coal Mining: IoT-Based Air Quality Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: The coal mining industry, a crucial element of global energy production, faces enduring challenges concerning air quality and worker safety. This research explores the integration of Internet of Things (IoT) technologies to drive digital transformation in coal mining. Specifically, to investigate an IoT-based air quality monitoring system designed for coal mining environments. This system deploys a network of strategically positioned sensors to continuously gather air quality data, including particulate matter and gases. Real-time transmission of this data to a central control hub enables immediate analysis and visualization, empowering timely decision-making. This IoT solution enhances miner safety and contributes to environmental sustainability by facilitating emissions reduction measures. By facilitating remote monitoring and informed decision-making, the system optimizes mining operations. This research underscores the potential of digital transformation in the coal mining industry, offering valuable insights for coal mining stakeholders, regulatory bodies, and companies seeking to modernize while addressing safety and environmental concerns.

articleTitle: Fish Freshness Detection Using UV Light Based On Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: Fish contains a lot of nutrients that are very beneficial for the body, but fish are often traded both live and dead. To observe the freshness of the fish, it is done by looking at the changes that occur in the fish's eyes and gills using UV imaging and image processing. Indicators of fish freshness quality can be seen through the color and smell. By using UV imaging can be seen the reaction that occurs in fish. Using UV light means freeing electrons from atoms or molecules, which can cause chemical reactions. After collecting data using UV imaging, the freshness level of the fish will be determined using deep learning. Deep learning is used to determine the level of segmentation of fish freshness. These results indicate that using DNN successfully assesses fish freshness non-destructively only by capturing fish images with UV light with a wavelength of 365-400 nm. By using segmentation based on RGB, CIE L*a*b, and HSV it is proven that this technique can accurately reveal changes in fish freshness with an R of 0.993. So that with this technique it is possible to evaluate the freshness level of fish non-destructively and classification of fish can be done online.

articleTitle: Improving Performance of Eye Movements Classification Using CNN-Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: In the past decade, eye tracking has been a crucial approach for object selection in digital assistive technology as well as touchless digital signage. Accurate object selection depends on performance of eye movements classification. Many deep learning techniques have been proposed for eye movements classification. Despite of these numerous models, previous approaches have yet to achieve high classficiation accuracy—particularly when dealing with smooth pursuit eye movement. To bridge this scientific gap and improve the effectiveness of eye movement classification, we propose a hybrid CNN-Transformer model. We also incorporated Hyperband hyperparameter tuning to obtain the best parameter values of the model. We evaluated our approach in the GazeCom dataset. This dataset was enhanced with customized annotations designed to accommodate different types of eye movements. Our method yielded F1 scores of 0.9572, 0.9273, and 0.8358 for fixation, saccade, and smooth pursuit eye movements, respectively. The proposed method achieved superior F1 scores by a margin of 1% to 12.36% compared with the state-of-the-art Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN). A significant improvement was observed in the classification of smooth pursuit eye movement. The experimental results imply that the proposed method can serve as a guide for implementing the Transformer models for eye movements classification.

articleTitle: Single-Phase UPS Inverter Using Offset-Free Optimizing Control with Digital All-Pass Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Advanced Mechatronics, Intelligent Manufacture and Industrial Automation (ICAMIMIA)
abstract: This study adopts a linear matrix inequalities (LMI)-based optimization approach to formulate a systematic control design for an LC-filtered single-phase DC-AC inverter. The proposed study’s optimization criteria define the LMI problems to provide fast output voltage response by reducing the time to steady state. Then, the stabilizing control gain is computed based on the LMI optimization criterion with help from the MATLAB toolbox. Integral control to eliminate offset error and state feedback control to provide closed-loop stability to the inverter system are the two features that make up the controller in this paper. In addition, an all-pass filter is employed for generating artificial voltage and current so that the states of the system can all be transformed and controlled in the dq-rotating frame.
